title: P2.19a Exclude recovery fixtures from production packages
description: Correct the containment gap left by P2.19: the recovery /1 JSON fixture is outside src but is still included by @moe/store pack and by the production daemon deploy/reshape path. Move or explicitly exclude the exact test-only bytes so production pack/deploy artifacts cannot contain them, and make the packaging gate inspect the artifact boundary rather than only source-directory names.
definitionOfDone: The exact fixture remains byte-for-byte available to tests and the strict /1 decoder assertions remain unchanged.
pnpm --dir packages/store pack --dry-run --json does not list the recovery fixture or any equivalent test-only recovery JSON.
A real isolated pnpm --filter @moe/daemon deploy --legacy --prod --config.node-linker=hoisted output contains no recovery fixture JSON under node_modules/@moe/store.
The production packaging inventory rejects a planted test-fixtures recovery JSON outside src; a mutation that re-admits it makes a named nonzero test fail.
@moe/store typecheck/tests and focused distribution inventory gates run from committed bytes with exact counts; pre-existing release-contract reds are baseline-compared and disclosed.
taskRails: Preserve the fixture bytes exactly; do not change recovery manifest semantics or v1/v2 compatibility.
Do not accept a source-only grep as packaging proof: measure pnpm pack and the production deploy/reshape artifact.
Preserve foreign WIP and commit only explicit owned paths after current-HEAD ownership checks.
